author: r-a-torrey
fields.title: Ekkubo ly’Obulokozi Nga Lyeyoleka ng’Omusana
fields.summary: Okuva ku kukaaba kw’omukuumi w’ekkomera ow’e Firipi, Torrey alaga ekkubo ly’obulokozi nga lyeyoleka ng’omusana — kkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo — era aggyawo okutabulwa okulemesa abanoonya okukkiriza mu bwangu.
main_points: Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu kwe kumutwala nga bwe yeewaayo: ng’Omwetikki w’ebibi era Omununuzi atuggya mu kibi.
Era yeewaayo ng’Omuyigiriza atasobya, Mukama, Omusana era Mukama waffe ow’Obwakatonda.
Okukkiriza kweyoleka mu kukakasa okusonyiyibwa, mu kumwesiga okufuna obuwanguzi, ne mu kusoma Ekigambo kye.
Kweyoleka mu kwewaayo, mu buwulize, mu kumugoberera, ne mu kumwatula mu maaso g’ensi.

study_questions.question: Torrey agamba nti okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo kitegeeza ki?
study_questions.answer: Torrey agamba nti “kkiriza” mu Bayibuli kitegeeza ddala ekyo kye kitegeeza mu kwogera okwa bulijjo: okwesiga omuntu nga bw’agamba nti bw’ali, ng’omusawo oba omuntu akuuma ensimbi mu bbanka. Okukkiriza Yesu kwe kumwesiga ng’Omwetikki w’ebibi byo, Omununuzi wo akuggya mu buyinza bw’ekibi, Omuyigiriza wo atasobya, Mukama wo, Omusana wo era Omukulembeze wo, era Mukama wo ow’obwakatonda.

study_questions.question: Torrey annyonnyola atya okuddamu Pawulo ne Siira kwe baawa omukuumi w’ekkomera ow’e Firipi mu Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:31?
study_questions.answer: Agamba nti tewali kyandibadde kyangu okutegeera okusinga ekyo: ekkubo ly’obulokozi kwe kukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo, era “mu kaseera ddala omusajja yenna oba omukazi oba omwana lw’akkiriza ddala” aba alokose. Akinyweza n’Ebikolwa by’Abatume 10:43, era akakasa nti n’oyo asingayo obubi eyagobwa mu bantu mu London, mu kaseera ako yandisanguddwako ekibi kye era n’afuulibwa omwana wa Katonda.

study_questions.question: Torrey anyumya mboozi ki ekwata ku buwanguzi ku kibi olwa Kristo eyazuukira?
study_questions.answer: Torrey anyumya ku musajja ow’e Scotland mu Chicago eyali afunye emirembe ng’alina emyaka musanvu olwa Yokaana 3:16, naye oluvannyuma n’afuuka omuddu w’omwenge. Torrey yamugamba nti yali akkirizza kitundu kimu kyokka eky’enjiri, nti Kristo yafa, n’amuleeta okwesiga Kristo eyazuukira alina “obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi” okumusumulula; wiiki ntono oluvannyuma omusajja n’awandiika nti, “Kikola!”

study_questions.question: Obubaka buno bugamba nti okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala mu Yesu kunaayoleka kutya?
study_questions.answer: Torrey abala okukakasa nti ebibi byo bisonyiyiddwa, okwesiga Kristo okufuna obuwanguzi ku kibi, okukkiriza awatali kubuusabuusa buli Yesu ky’agamba, okusoma ekigambo kye, okuwaayo obulamu bwonna mu buyinza bwe, obuwulize obwa buli lunaku, okumugoberera buli gy’akulembera, n’okumwatula mu lwatu mu maaso g’ensi. Abifunza bw’ati: “Ekikolwa eky’okukkiriza kya kaseera kamu, ebibala by’okukkiriza bya bulamu bwonna.”

fields.body_html:
“Omukuumi w’ekkomera n’akankana nnyo ng’ajjudde entiisa nnyingi, n’alagira ne baleeta ettaala, n’afubutuka n’ayingira munda, n’agwa wansi mu maaso ga Pawulo ne Siira ng’akankana. Awo n’abafulumya, n’ababuuza nti, ‘Bassebo, nkole ki okulokolebwa?’ Ne bamugamba nti, ‘Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa, ggwe n’ennyumba yo yonna.’” — Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:29-31

Omukuumi w’ekkomera ow’e Firipi, olw’ebintu ebyagwawo ebiddiriŋŋana, bye nsomye mu kyawandiikibwa eky’ekiro kino, yali atuusiddwa okutegeera nti yali mwonoonyi abuze, era ng’alina okwegomba okw’amaanyi okulokolebwa, n’abuuza Pawulo ne Siira ekibuuzo kino ekitereevu, “Nkole ki okulokolebwa?” Pawulo n’amuddamu mu bigambo by’ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe, “Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa.” Tewali kyandibadde kyangu okutegeera okusinga ekyo, tewali kyandibadde kitereevu okusinga ekyo, tewali kyandibadde kikakafu okusinga ekyo. Ekkubo ly’obulokozi kwe kukkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, era mu kaseera ddala omusajja yenna oba omukazi oba omwana lw’akkiriza ddala Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, aba alokose. Singa omusajja oba omukazi asingayo okubula mu London yandiyingidde mu kizimbe kino ekiro kino, n’akkiriza Mukama Yesu wano, oba mu lukuŋŋaana oluddirira, oba ng’amaze okufuluma, mu kaseera ddala lw’akikola yandibadde alokose. Omuntu ayinza okugamba nti, “Naye kino kyali kigambo ekyagambibwa omusajja omu yekka; olina buyinza ki okugamba nti omuntu yenna alirokolebwa mu ngeri y’emu?” Kubanga ekintu kye kimu kyogerwa emirundi n’emirundi mu Bayibuli. Okugeza, osoma mu Ebikolwa by’Abatume 10:43, “bannabbi bonna bamuweera obujulirwa nti buli amukkiriza asonyiyibwa ebibi mu linnya lye.” Tewali musajja oba mukazi mu kizimbe kino ekiro kino eyeetaaga okukifulumamu nga ebibi bye byonna tebisonyiyiddwa era tebisangulibbwaawo. Kikolwa kimu kyokka, “Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa.”

1. OKUKKIRIZA MUKAMA YESU KITEGEEZA KI.

Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu kitegeeza ki? Twetaaga okwegendereza ennyo mu kuddamu ekibuuzo ekyo, kubanga waliwo okuddamu kungi okutali kutuufu era okutali kwa mazima. Waliwo abantu aboogera era abalowooza nti bakkiriza Mukama Yesu, naye nga tebamukkiriza. Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu kitegeeza ki? Nsomye ensonga eno n’obwegendereza bungi era mu bujjuvu; ngenze mu Bayibuli yange yonna nga nnoonya ekigambo “kkiriza,” n’ebigambo byonna ebikwatagana nakyo, era nzudde kye nnali nteebereza nga ge mazima bwe nnatandika, kwe kugamba, nti “kkiriza” mu Bayibuli kitegeeza ddala ekyo kye kitegeeza mu kwogera okw’ennaku zino. Okukkiriza omuntu kye ki? Okukkiriza omuntu kitegeeza okumwesiga nga bw’agamba nti bw’ali. Okukkiriza omusawo kitegeeza okumwesiga ng’omusawo, ne kikuleetera okuteeka obulwadde bwo mu mikono gye. Okukkiriza omusomesa kwe kumwesiga ng’omusomesa n’okukkiriza by’ayigiriza; okukkiriza omuntu akuuma ensimbi mu bbanka kitegeeza okumwesiga ng’oyo, n’okuteeka ensimbi zo mu bbanka ye. Era okukkiriza Mukama Yesu kitegeeza okumwesiga nga bw’agamba nti bw’ali.

Okwesiga Mukama Yesu nga ki? Nga byonna by’agamba nti y’ali, era byonna by’atuwaayo nti y’ali. Mukama Yesu agamba nti ye ani, era yeewaayo gye tuli nga ani?

1. Ekisooka, Mukama Yesu yeewaayo eri buli omu ku ffe ng’Omwetikki w’ebibi. Mu Matayo 20:28, agamba nti, “Omwana w’Omuntu atajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi.” Yeewaayo ng’omutango ku lwa bonna. Ekirowoozo ekyo kiyita mu Bayibuli yonna, mu Ndagaano Enkadde nga bwe kiri mu Mpya. Bw’oba oyagala okukisanga mu Ndagaano Enkadde, kyuka ku Isaaya 53:6: “Ffenna twawaba ng’endiga; buli omu ku ffe n’akwata ekkubo lye; Mukama n’amuteekako (kwe kugamba, ku Mukama Yesu) obutali butuukirivu bwaffe ffenna.” Bw’oba oyagala okukisanga mu Ndagaano Empya kyuka ku 1 Peetero 2:24: “Yesu Kristo yennyini yeetikka ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe bwe yatufiirira ku musaalaba, naffe tulyoke tufe eri ekibi, tube abalamu eri obutuukirivu. Olw’ebiwundu bye, muwonyezebbwa.” Kristo yeewaayo eri buli muntu ng’Omwetikki w’ebibi, era okukkiriza Mukama Yesu kwe kumwesiga ng’Omwetikki w’ebibi byo.

2. Eky’okubiri, Mukama Yesu yeewaayo gye tuli ng’Omununuzi atuggya mu buyinza bw’ekibi. Agamba mu Yokaana 8:34, “buli akola ekibi aba muddu wa kibi.” Era ffenna tumanyi nti ekyo kya mazima, kubanga ffenna twakola ekibi, ne tufuuka abaddu b’ekibi, era tewali muntu ayinza kwesumattula ku kibi mu maanyi ge. Agamba, mu Yokaana 8:36, “Kale, Omwana bw’alibafuula ab’eddembe, mulibeerera ddala ba ddembe.” Mukama Yesu yeewaayo eri buli omu ku ffe ng’Oyo alina obuyinza okutusumulula okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi. Agamba nti Setaani ye musajja ow’amaanyi eyeesibye ebyokulwanyisa, naye nti Ye yennyini wa maanyi okusinga Setaani. Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu kwe kwesiga Yesu ng’Oyo alina obuyinza okukusumulula okuva mu kibi.

3. Eky’okusatu, Kristo yeewaayo gye tuli ng’Omuyigiriza eyayigirizibwa Katonda era atasobya n’akatono. Mu Yokaana 14:10, agamba nti, “Kale munzikirize nti ndi mu Kitange era nga ne Kitange ali mu Nze. Oba si ekyo munzikirize olw’emirimu gyokka. Ebigambo bye mbategeeza si byange ku bwange, wabula biva eri Kitange abeera mu Nze, era akola emirimu ng’ayita mu Nze.” Yeewaayo gy’oli ng’Omuyigiriza akubuulira ebigambo bya Katonda, atayogera bigambo bibye ku bubwe; ng’Omuyigiriza abeera mu Katonda, era Katonda mw’abeera, Omuyigiriza eyayigirizibwa Katonda era atasobya n’akatono; era okukkiriza Kristo kwe kumwesiga bw’atyo.

4. Eky’okuna, Mukama Yesu yeewaayo gye tuli nga Mukama waffe, alina eddembe ery’okufuga obulamu bwaffe bwonna. Mu Yokaana 15:14, agamba nti, “Muba mikwano gyange bwe mukola bye mbalagira.” Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu kwe kwesiga Yesu nga Mukama alina eddembe ery’okufuga obulamu bwo bwonna era mu bujjuvu.

5. Nate, Mukama Yesu Kristo yeewaayo gye tuli ng’omusana era omukulembeze. Agamba mu Yokaana 8:12, “Nze Musana gw’ensi. Angoberera taatambulirenga mu kizikiza, wabula anaabeeranga n’omusana ogw’obulamu.” Okukkiriza Yesu kwe kumwesiga ng’Omusana gw’ensi, ng’Oyo gw’oteekwa okugoberera buli gy’akulembera.

6. Era ekisembayo, Mukama Yesu yeewaayo gye tuli nga Mukama waffe ow’Obwakatonda. Agamba mu Yokaana 13:13: “Mmwe mumpita Muyigiriza era Mukama wammwe, mukola bulungi okumpita bwe mutyo kubanga ddala bwe ntyo bwe ndi.” Era tusoma mu Yokaana 20:28-29, nti Tomasi bwe yalaba Yesu Kristo ng’amaze okuzuukira, n’akakasa ku nkomerero nti ddala yali azuukidde mu bafu, yayimusa emikono gye n’agamba Yesu nti, “Ggwe Mukama wange era Katonda wange.” Era Yesu n’atendereza Tomasi olw’okwatula kuno, ng’amugamba nti, “Okkirizza kubanga ondabye. Balina omukisa abakkiriza nga tebaliiko kye balabye.” Yesu yeewaayo gye tuli nga Mukama waffe ow’obwakatonda. Okukkiriza Yesu kwe kumwesiga nga Mukama waffe ow’obwakatonda.

Kale, okubifunza byonna, okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo kwe kumwesiga ng’Omwetikki w’ebibi byo, ng’Omununuzi wo akuggya mu buyinza bw’ekibi, ng’Omuyigiriza wo eyayigirizibwa Katonda era atasobya n’akatono, nga Mukama wo alina eddembe ery’okufuga obulamu bwo bwonna, ng’Omusana wo era Omukulembeze wo gw’onoogobereranga buli gy’akulembera, era nga Mukama wo ow’obwakatonda. Mu kaseera ddala lw’oteeka bw’otyo obwesige bwo, obwesige bwo bwonna, mu Yesu Kristo, mu kaseera ako olokolebwa. “Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa.”

2. OKUKKIRIZA BWE KWEYOLEKA.

Naye tunaayoleka tutya okukkiriza kwaffe? Mu bigambo ebirala, bwe tuba nga ddala tukkirizza Mukama Yesu Kristo era nga ddala tulokose, tunaakyoleka tutya?

1. Ekisooka, tujja kukyoleka nga tukakasa nti ebibi byaffe byonna bisonyiyiddwa. Bwe mba nga ddala nteeka obwesige bwange mu Yesu ng’Omwetikki w’ebibi byange, nga mmwesiga ng’Oyo eyeetikka ebibi byange byonna, eby’emabega, ebya kaakano, n’eby’omu maaso, mu kaseera ddala lwe mmwesiga bw’atyo, mmanyi nti sikyabyetikka, era nkakasa nti buli kibi kye nnali nkoze kisonyiyiddwa. Mu Lukka 7 tusoma ku mukazi eyali omwonoonyi. Yali agobeddwa mu bantu. Naye n’ayingira mu nnyumba Yesu mwe yali ng’atudde ku mmeeza, abantu ne balowooza nti Yesu tayinza kuba nnabbi kubanga yamukkiriza okumukwatako. Naye Yesu, bwe yalaba okukkiriza kwe, n’agamba nti, “Osonyiyiddwa ebibi byo… Okukkiriza kwo kukulokodde, genda mirembe.” Omukazi oyo bwe yafuluma mu kifo ekyo yali amanyi nti ebibi bye bisonyiyiddwa. Singa wamusisinkana mu luguudo n’omugamba nti, “Omanyi nti ebibi byo bisonyiyiddwa?” yandikuzeemu nti “Yee, nkimanyi; nkikakasa.” “Lwaki okikakasa?” “Kubanga yaŋŋamba bw’atyo, n’olwekyo nkimanyi.” “Naye okiwulira; owulira nga ebibi byo bisonyiyiddwa?” Kirabika yandizeemu nti, “Sinnakiwulira; amawulire malungi nnyo ne kiba nti sisobola kukitegeera bulungi, naye nkakasa nti bwe kiri; nkimanyi, kubanga yagamba bw’atyo.” “Kale,” wandigambye nti, “tolina kukakasa bw’otyo okuggyako ng’okiwulira.” Naye yandikuzeemu nti, “Ayi, nkakasa.” Naye ojja kugamba nti, “Oyinza otya okukakasa nga tokiwulira?” Naye yandigambye nti, “Kubanga yagamba bw’atyo.”

2. Eky’okubiri, bw’oba ng’okkirizza Mukama Yesu Kristo, kijja kweyoleka mu kumutunuulira n’okumwesiga okukuwa obuwanguzi ku kibi. Bw’omwesiga ng’Omununuzi akuggya mu buyinza bw’ekibi, ddala ojja kumutunuulira, era omwesige okukusumulula okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi. Tojja kugamba nti, “Ebibi byange binene nnyo ne kiba nti tayinza kundokola.” Tojja kutunuulira bunene bw’ekibi kyo n’akatono. Ojja kutunuulira bukulu bwa Mulokozi wo.

Lumu omusajja yajja gye ndi mu Chicago, n’agamba nti, “Mw. Torrey, njagala okwogera naawe ffembi fekka”; ne mmutwala waggulu mu wofiisi ya Mw. Moody—Mw. Moody yali taliiwo mu kiseera ekyo. N’agamba nti, “Njagala okukubuulira ebyafaayo byange.” Ne ŋŋamba nti, “Kale; tuula”; n’atandika okumbuulira ebyafaayo by’obulamu bwe. N’agamba nti: “Eyo mu Scotland, bwe nnali wa myaka musanvu gyokka, nnatandika okusoma Bayibuli yonna,” (ekintu ekirungi omulenzi okukola) “ne ntuuka ku Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri. Bwe nnali nsoma eyo ne nsanga nti omuntu bw’akwata amateeka gonna okumala emyaka kikumi, n’oluvannyuma n’agamenya mu kifo kyonna, aba ali wansi w’ekikolimo. Ekyo kituufu?” Ne ŋŋamba nti, “Kale, ekyo si kye kyawandiikibwa ddala, naye ye nsonga yaakyo enkulu.” N’agenda mu maaso nti, “Nnali mulenzi wa myaka musanvu gyokka, naye nnajjula okuwulira nti ndi wansi w’ekikolimo kya Katonda, era ekyo ne kimala kumpi omwaka mulamba. Ne ntuuka ku Ndagaano Empya, ne nsoma Yokaana 3:16: ‘Kubanga Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka, buli muntu yenna amukkiriza aleme kuzikirira, wabula afune obulamu obutaggwaawo.’ Ne ndaba nti Mukama Yesu yali yeetisse ebibi byange byonna, n’omugugu gwange ne guvaawo.” N’agamba nti, “Nnali nkyuse?” Ne muddamu nti, “Ekyo kiwulikika ng’okukyuka okw’enjiri okwa nnamaddala.” Awo n’agamba nti, “Linda katono; ka nkubuulire ebyafaayo byange ebisigadde. Oluvannyuma lw’emyaka egimu nnajja e Chicago, era kaakano nkola wansi eyo mu bifo awakuumirwa ente ezigenda okuttibwa. Omanyi ekitundu ekyo; kitundu kizibu nnyo. Nnafuuka omunywi w’omwenge, era buli kaseera katono ngwa wansi w’obuyinza bw’omwenge omukambwe. Ngezaako okwesumattula, naye sisobola. Kye nzize okukubuuza kye kino, waliwo engeri yonna ey’okufuna obuwanguzi ku kibi?” Ne ŋŋamba nti “Ozze ddala eri omuntu omutuufu; ekyo nnyinza okukikubuulira.” N’agamba nti, “Nkwegayiridde kikole.” Ne nzigula Bayibuli yange ku 1 Abakkolinso 15, ne nsoma ennyiriri ennya ezisooka: “Abooluganda, mbajjukiza Enjiri gye nababuulira era gye mwakkiriza era gye munywereddemu. Mulokolebwa lwa Njiri eyo gye nababuulira, bwe muginywererako, naye bwe kitaba bwe kityo muba mwakkiririza bwereere. Kubanga nabategeeza ekigambo ekikulu ennyo nange kye nnaweebwa ekigamba nti Kristo yafa olw’ebibi byaffe, ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bigamba, era nti yaziikibwa, n’azuukizibwa ku lunaku olwokusatu ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bigamba.”

“Kaakano,” ne ŋŋamba nti, “wakkiriza nti Yesu Kristo yafa olw’ebibi byo.” N’agamba nti, “Nakkiriza.” “Wafuna emirembe mu kukkiriza.” “Nagifuna.” Ne ŋŋamba nti, “Naye wakkiriza kitundu kimu kyokka eky’Enjiri, nti Kristo yafa olw’ebibi byaffe, ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bigamba, era nti yaziikibwa. Onookkiriza kaakano ekitundu ekirala eky’Enjiri? Onookkiriza nti yazuukira?” N’agamba nti, “Nkkiriza; nkkiriza buli kintu ekiri mu Bayibuli.” Ne nziramu nti, “Okkiriza ddala nti Yesu yazuukira?” n’agamba nti, “Nkkiriza.” Ne ŋŋamba nti, “Okkiriza Yesu Kristo ky’agamba mu Matayo 28:18, ‘Mpeereddwa obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi’?” “Yee.” “Kale alina obuyinza okukusumulula okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi. Okikkiriza?” N’agamba nti, “Nkikkiriza.” Ne ŋŋamba nti, “Onoomwesiga kaakano ddala, akikole?” N’agamba nti, “Nja kumwesiga.” “Kale bulungi,” ne ŋŋamba nti, “ka tufukamire,” ne nsaba, naye n’addirira n’okusaba okwali nga kuno: “Ayi Katonda, nnakkiriza nti Yesu yafiira ebibi byange ku Musaalaba, ne nfuna emirembe olw’okukkiriza, era kaakano nkkiriza nti Yesu yazuukira, era nti alina obuyinza bwonna mu Ggulu ne ku nsi, era alina obuyinza okunsumulula leero. Mukama Yesu, nsumulula okuva mu buyinza bw’omwenge n’obuyinza bw’ekibi.” Bwe yamala okusaba, ne mmugamba nti, “Onoomwesiga akikole?” N’agamba nti, “Nja kumwesiga,” era bw’atyo bwe yakola. Mu wiiki ntono ne nfuna ebbaluwa okuva eri omusajja oyo mwe yagamba nti, “Nsanyuse nnyo okuba nga nnajja okukulaba. Kikola!”

Kristo teyakoma ku kufa kyokka, naye yazuukira, era Mulokozi mulamu ekiro kino. Alina obuyinza bwonna mu Ggulu ne ku nsi, era Setaani tasobola kumuwangula; Kristo eyazuukira alina obuyinza okumenya enjegere z’omwenge omukambwe, okumenya enjegere za opiyamu, okumenya enjegere z’okwegomba okubi, n’eza buli kibi; era bw’onoomwesiga okukikukolera, ajja kukikola. Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo kitegeeza okumutunuulira n’okumwesiga okukuwa obuwanguzi ku kibi.

3. Eky’okusatu, kijja kweyoleka mu kukkiriza kwo awatali kubuusabuusa, nti buli Yesu ky’agamba kya mazima ag’enkomeredde era kirina obuyinza obujjuvu. Bwe mba nga nnesiga Yesu ng’Omuyigiriza eyayigirizibwa Katonda era atasobya n’akatono, kyonna kye nsanga mu Bayibuli Yesu ky’agamba, nja kukikkiriza. Nnyinza obutakitegeera, kiyinza okulabika ng’ekitasoboka, era abayivu bayinza okumpakanya, naye nkkiriza Mukama Yesu, era by’agamba mbikkiriza mu bujjuvu mu buwanvu bwabyo bwonna, obuwanvu bw’okukka, obuwanvu, n’obugazi. Abantu bangi leero beeyita okukkiriza Mukama Yesu, naye bwe basanga Yesu ng’ayigiriza ekintu ekimu, abantu ne babagamba nti abayivu ab’ennaku zino bonna bakkaanya nti kirala, bakkiriza abayivu ab’ennaku zino bye bakkaanyizaako, ne basuula enjigiriza ya Kristo. Bassebo, nkakasa nti abantu abo tebakkiriza Mukama Yesu. Bakkiriza “abayivu ab’ennaku zino bye bakkaanyizaako,” era okukkiriza abayivu ab’ennaku zino bye bakkaanyizaako tekulokolangako muntu yenna. Kuzikirizza bangi. Oyinza otya okugamba nti okkiriza Yesu bw’oba tokkiriza by’agamba? Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu kitegeeza okumwesiga, okumwesiga mu bujjuvu, nga bw’agamba nti bw’ali; era agamba nti Muyigiriza eyayigirizibwa Katonda, ayogera ebigambo bya Katonda byokka.

Tuli mu kiseera kya kunoonyereza kungi mwe tubeera, era ekibuuzo kiri nti, tunaakkiriza abayivu b’e Bugirimaani nga bwe bayitibwa, oba Mukama Yesu Kristo? Kale, mu kuddamu ekibuuzo ekyo, ŋŋamba nti Mukama Yesu Kristo ayimiridde okumala ebyasa kkumi na mwenda, ate okuyiga kw’Abagirimaani tekuyimirirangako myaka kkumi na etaano egiddiriŋŋana; era nze njagala kukkiriza Mukama Yesu.

4. Okukkiriza kwaffe mu ye kujja kweyolekera mu kusoma Ekigambo kye. Bwe mba nga nkkiriza Mukama Yesu, nja kusoma ekigambo kye emirundi n’emirundi. Ka tugambe nti omusajja omu yandizze mu London ng’agamba nti muyigiriza eyayigirizibwa Katonda era atasobya n’akatono, era ng’omukkiriza. Tewandisomye buli kigambo ky’ayogedde? Tulina omusajja mu Amerika agamba nti si muyigiriza eyayigirizibwa Katonda era atasobya n’akatono kyokka, naye mubaka atumiddwa butereevu okuva eri Katonda. Singa nnakkiriza nti ddala yali muyigiriza atumiddwa okuva eri Katonda, nnandisomye buli kigambo kye yayogera, nga bwe bakola ebikumi n’ebikumi mu Chicago. Bamala ebiseera bingi nga basoma ebigambo bye okusinga bye bamala nga basoma Bayibuli zaabwe. Bwe kityo bwe kiri, bwe mba nga nkkiriza Yesu nga bw’agamba nti bw’ali, Omuyigiriza eyayigirizibwa Katonda era atasobya n’akatono, kye nnaasomanga okusinga byonna kiriba bigambo bya Yesu yennyini.

5. Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo kujja kweyoleka mu kuwaayo obulamu bwonna mu buyinza bwe. Bwe mba nga nnesiga Yesu nga bw’agamba nti bw’ali—Mukama wange, alina eddembe ery’okufuga obulamu bwange bwonna—nja kuteeka obulamu bwange bwonna mu buyinza bwe. Okikoze? Ogamba nti oli Mukristaayo, okkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo. Okiraga ng’oteeka obulamu bwo bwonna mu buyinza bwe?

6. Ekiddako, ojja kwoleka okukkiriza kwo mu Mukama Yesu Kristo ng’omugondera mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku, mu buli ky’akugamba okukola. Mu Lukka 6:46, agamba nti, “Lwaki mumpita nti, ‘Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe,’ so nga bye mbagamba si bye mukola?” Nzikiriza nti ayogera kye kimu eri Abakristaayo b’omu London, abo abeeyatula okuba Abakristaayo. Mumuyita nti “Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe,” buli lunaku lwa Ssabbiiti mu bulamu bwammwe, ate ne muyita mu buli lunaku lwa wiiki nga mubeera mu bulamu ddala bw’abagamba obutabeeramu, era ne mugaana okukola ky’abagamba mu lwatu okukola. Kaakano Mukama Yesu bwe yali wano ku nsi ng’awonya abantu, yasabanga okukkiriza ng’ekisaanyizo ekisooka okuwonyezebwa, era yasabanga baleke okukkiriza kwabwe kweyoleke mu bikolwa byabwe. Asaba okukkiriza leero ng’ekisaanyizo ekisooka okulokolebwa, era bw’omala okulokolebwa, asaba olage okukkiriza kwo mu bikolwa byo, okole ky’akugamba. Ekyo kifuula abamu ku mmwe okulabika nga temuli mu ddembe. Kinsanyusa; kabonero kalungi. Abamu ku mmwe abeeyatula okuba Abakristaayo mwetaaga okuleetebwa okukakasibwa ku kibi. Mubadde musaba abali ebweru bakakasibwe ku kibi, naye bangi nnyo ku mmwe mwetaaga okukakasibwa ku kibi mmwe mwennyini; era bwe munaakakasibwa ku kibi, abali ebweru bangi okusingawo bajja kukakasibwa ku kibi.

7. Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo kujja kweyoleka nate mu kumugoberera buli gy’akulembera. Bwe mba nga nnesiga Yesu Kristo ng’Omusana gw’ensi, nja kumugoberera, kubanga “Angoberera taatambulirenga mu kizikiza, wabula anaabeeranga n’omusana ogw’obulamu.” “Oyo agamba nti ali mu ye, asaana okutambula nga Mukama waffe yennyini bwe yatambula.” Ogoberera mu bigere bye, mu bizinensi yo, mu bulamu bwo n’abantu, mu bulamu bwo obw’ekyama, mu bulamu bwo ggwe kennyini buli wamu?

8. Okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo kujja kweyoleka mu kumwatula mu maaso g’ensi, ne mu kumuwaako obujulirwa eri abantu. Tusoma mu Abaruumi 10:9-10: “Bw’oyatula n’akamwa ko nti, Yesu ye Mukama, n’okkiriza n’omutima gwo nga Katonda yamuzuukiza mu bafu, olokoka. Kubanga omuntu akkiriza na mutima gwe n’aweebwa obutuukirivu, era ayatula na kamwa ke n’alokoka.”

Leero nfunye ebbaluwa okuva eri omusajja eyagamba nti kizibu nnyo okusuubira abantu okuyimirira okwatula Kristo mu ngeri gye mbasaba, n’agenda mu maaso okumbuulira engeri ennyangu okusingawo ey’okukikola. Naye sinoonya ngeri nnyangu okusingawo. Nkyawa nnyo engeri zino ennyangu. Nzikiriza mu kuleeta abantu okukyuka. Nnandisobodde okugaba kaadi ne mbaleetera okuteekako amannya gaabwe, nga bagamba nti basuubira okugenda mu ggulu; naye omwezi gumu nga mmaze okugenda ekyandivuddemu kyandibadde kya bwereere, oba kibi okusinga obwereere. Sikkiriza n’akatono kukkiriza kwonna okutaleeta kwatula Kristo mu lwatu mu maaso g’ensi, era sikkiriza n’akatono Bukristaayo bwa Bakristaayo bammwe abeeyatula okuggyako nga bubaleetera okugenda mu nsi okuwa obujulirwa ku Oyo eyabalokola. “Akamwa koogera ku biba bijjudde mu mutima.”

Kaakano nkubuuza ekibuuzo. Okkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo? Walowooza nti omukkiriza bwe wayingira, naye ddala omukkiriza? Nsabye Katonda mu kusaba kwange asaanyeewo amasuubi ag’obulimba ekiro kino. Okkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo? Kintu kimu okugamba nti okkiriza, n’ekirala okukkiriza. Bw’oba tomukkiriza, onoomukkiriza kaakano, mu kaseera kano? Onoomwesiga Yesu Kristo mu kaseera kano ng’Omwetikki w’ebibi byo, ng’Omununuzi akuggya mu buyinza bw’ekibi, ng’Omuyigiriza eyayigirizibwa Katonda era atasobya n’akatono, nga Mukama alina eddembe ery’okufuga obulamu bwo bwonna, ng’Omusana gw’ensi, nga Mukama wo ow’Obwakatonda? Onookikola? Kitwala kaseera kamu kokka okukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo. Kiyinza okukolebwa mu kaseera katono. Naye kijja kutwala obulamu bwo bwonna okulaga nti wamukkiriza ng’omaze okukikola. Ekikolwa eky’okukkiriza kya kaseera kamu, ebibala by’okukkiriza bya bulamu bwonna. Onoomwesiga ekiro kino? Bw’onookikola, ebivaamu bijja kuddirira, era bw’oba tokikolangako, oyinza okukikola kaakano. Oyinza okukikola nga Mw. Alexander tannayimba.

Era mmwe abasajja n’abakazi abateeyatulangako kukkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo, munaateeka obwesige bwammwe mu Mukama Yesu Kristo kaakano? Mu kaseera ddala lw’onookikola, ojja kulokolebwa. Nja kugamba omusajja oba omukazi yenna atalokoleddwa n’akatono, nti mu kaseera akaddako oyinza okulokolebwa. Nja kugamba omusajja oba omukazi yenna atalokoleddwa n’akatono, ayagala okudduka okuva wansi w’obusungu bwa Katonda n’ajja wansi w’omusana ogujjuvu ogw’ekisa kya Katonda, nti oyinza okukikola mu kaseera katono. Otya? Kkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo; mwesige Mukama Yesu Kristo nga bw’agamba nti bw’ali. Singa omuntu asingayo obubi eyagobwa mu bantu mu London yandibadde mu kisenge kino kaakano, n’amala wano kaakano n’ateeka obwesige mu Yesu nga byonna by’agamba nti y’ali, mu kaseera ddala lwe yandikikoze Katonda yandisangudde ebibi bye byonna, n’amubalira obutuukirivu bwonna obwa Kristo; n’amusumulula okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi, n’amufuula omwana wa Katonda. Eby’edda byandivuddewo mu kaseera katono, era byonna ne bifuuka biggya. Ayi, eky’amagero ky’okuzaalibwa obuggya! Ndabye omusajja mu kaseera kamu nga mutamiivu, ng’atamidde ekitundu mu kiseera ekyo, ng’azibula amaaso ge ekimala okulaba amazima agakwata ku Mukama Yesu n’amwesiga, era mu kaseera akaddako nnali ntunuulira amaaso g’omwana wa Katonda.

Ekiro kimu mu Chicago, mu Pacific Garden Mission, mwayingiramu omusajja omwavu, eyali ayonoonese ddala mu mubiri ne mu mpisa. Yali agudde ku kabenje k’eggaali y’omukka era yali mulema ddala, nga tasobola kukozesa bigere byombi, nga yeekulula ku miggo. Okumala emyaka kkumi n’ena yali muddu wa wiski n’omwenge mu ngeri zaagwo zonna, era ne opiyamu. Yali muddu wa opiyamu era muddu wa mwenge. Mukwano gwange Colonel Clark yayogera naye n’amubuulira Enjiri ya Yesu Kristo, naye n’agaana okukkiriza. Naye ku luguudo La Salle, emu ku nguudo zaffe ez’obusuubuzi ezisingayo okujjula abantu, olunaku olwaddirira, Colonel Clark n’alaba omusajja y’omu nga yeekulula ku miggo gye, era bwe yatuuka ku mulyango gw’akakubo akafunda, Colonel Clark n’amusikira mu kakubo ako n’amugamba nti, “Mukwano gwange, Yesu alina obuyinza okukulokola,” era bwe yamala okwogera naye akaseera, awo wennyini omusajja n’afukamira nga bwe yasobola ku miggo gye, ku mabbali g’omusajja wa Katonda ow’amaanyi, n’ateeka obwesige bwe mu Yesu Kristo. Era omusajja oyo bwe yafuluma mu kakubo ako yafuluma ng’omwana wa Katonda, era leero mubuulizi w’Enjiri. Katonda yeebazibwe olw’Enjiri esobola okulokola omuntu yenna. Toyinza kunsangira musajja mu London yonna Yesu Kristo gw’atalina buyinza kulokola bw’anaamukkiriza obukkiriza. Mwesige. Onookkiriza Mukama Yesu Kristo ekiro kino?
